snippet.title: Bases Loaded (Game Boy) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game: Bases Loaded GB (Bases Loaded for Game Boy)
Platform: Nintendo Game Boy
Release Year: 1990

A full game of the portable edition of Bases Loaded. Not all that similar to the NES version of Bases Loaded. Recorded on the Game Boy Player for GameCube. 

***
